# Compounding RX USA

> > A specialty compounding pharmacy offering customized pharmaceutical solutions for pain management, hormone optimization, erectile dysfunction, and specialized medical conditions with nationwide shipping.

Compounding RX USA (also known as Compounding Pharmacy of America) is a licensed compounding pharmacy based in Knoxville, TN that specializes in creating custom medications tailored to individual patient needs. The pharmacy serves multiple medical specialties including dermatology, urology, sports medicine, and pediatrics, while also offering a health and wellness shop with supplements and fitness products.

## Key Topics

- Custom compounding medications
- Hormone replacement therapy (HRT)
- Erectile dysfunction treatment
- Topical pain relief gels
- Pharmaceutical services
- Pain management
- Men's health optimization
- Women's health screening
- Dermatology treatments
- Pediatric medications
- Sterile compounding (USP <797>)
- Weight loss medications
- Sports medicine pharmacy
- Palliative care
- Preventive health screening

## Specialty Compounding Services

- [Specialized Compounding Pharmacy Services | How Compounding Works](https://compoundingrxusa.com/services): Overview of specialty pharmaceutical services including pain management and HRT
- [Erectile Dysfunction Pharmacy | Compounding Medications](https://compoundingrxusa.com/services/erectile-dysfunction): ED treatment alternatives to Viagra, Cialis, and Levitra
- [Compounding Medications for Hormone Male and Female Replacement](https://compoundingrxusa.com/services/hormone-optimization): BHRT services for testosterone, estrogen, and progesterone optimization
- [Compounded Topical Pain Relief Creams and Gels](https://compoundingrxusa.com/services/topical-pain-gels): Topical pain relief alternatives to ibuprofen and acetaminophen
- [Custom Medications for Weight Loss Management](https://compoundingrxusa.com/services/weight-loss): Personalized weight loss medications for medical weight management

## Medical Specialty Services

- [Compounded Dermatology Medications to Help with Skin Conditions](https://compoundingrxusa.com/services/dermatology): Compounded dermatology treatments including BLT Gels for skin conditions
- [A Dental Topical Anesthetic Gel That Removes Fear](https://compoundingrxusa.com/services/dental): Dental topical anesthetic gel for anxiety and pain management
- [Ophthalmology Compounding Services | Sterile Compounding Pharmacy](https://compoundingrxusa.com/services/ophthalmology): USP <797> compliant sterile compounding for eye drops and ophthalmology
- [Compounded Urology Medications Treat Fundamental Issues](https://compoundingrxusa.com/services/urology): Custom urology medications for prostate and urinary tract health
- [Sports Medicine Compounding Services | Sports Pharmacy](https://compoundingrxusa.com/services/sports-medicine): Custom sports medicine medications for athletes' pain and injury recovery
- [Custom Compounding Medicines for Podiatry Issues](https://compoundingrxusa.com/services/podiatry): Compounded topical medications for foot pain and fungal infections

## Specialized Patient Care

- [Pediatric Compounding Services for Children's Medications](https://compoundingrxusa.com/services/pediatric): Custom pediatric medications with flavoring and dosage customization
- [Hospice & Palliative Medicine | Palliative & Hospice Pharmacy](https://compoundingrxusa.com/services/palliative-care-hospice): Hospice and palliative care medications with custom dosages
- [Compounding Medications for Wound and Scar Therapy | Help with Scarring](https://compoundingrxusa.com/services/wounds-scars): Compounded treatments for keloids, burn scars, and surgical scars
